Touchdown on Yamato

Is everybody here?
Then let’s begin.
The two remaining Pandemonium Regaliar were not found in the Mikasa.
So do you think they’re even deeper down... In Yamato?
So it would seem...
Yamato, huh...
... Kaede, do you think that  demons being in the Mikasa means...
This “Yamato” will have even stronger demons, no doubt.
Do you think it’ll still be safe for <NAME> to go with us?
<NAME> did rescue Kanna and Iris, did he not? There’s no need to worry.
He’ll be fine.
You can do this, right, <NAME>?
Yes!
Maybe...
Yes! I know I can!!
Splendid, well said.
Stay safe and don’t overdo it, okay, <NAME>?

Maybe...
I mean, I THINK I can, but...
Hearing you say that, one could hardly imagine you’d just rescued Kanna and Iris.
Have a little confidence in yourself, <NAME>.
Okay.
Show a little more confidence, <NAME>. You’re a man, aren’t you?
Y-Yes.
<NAME>, we’ll have you partner up with another member of the Flower Division...
And the two of you will look for the Pandemonium Regalia.
<NAME>, you are hereby ordered to investigate Yamato.
Stay alert, and stay safe.
